segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קסא
הַמַּחֲלֹקֶת מַגְבִּיהַּ וּמֵרִים אֶת הָאָדָם, כִּמְשַׁל הַמַּיִם שׁוֹטְפִים שֶׁמְּנַשְּׂאִים וּמְרִימִים אֶת הָעֵץ הַשּׁוֹכֵב עַל הָאָרֶץ:
segments.en: And the primary settling of the mind is through joy. For through joy one can direct one's mind as one wishes — and settle one's mind to think about one's eternal purpose. For joy is the world of freedom. And therefore when one connects joy to one's mind — one's mind is in freedom and not in exile. And one can settle one's mind as above.
